svg.title: DriveGuard AI — System Architecture
svg.desc: 5-layer architecture: Data and Input, Detection and Measurement Pipeline, AI Notice Generation, Serving and Storage, Monitoring Dashboard
svg.text: DriveGuard AI — Real-Time Traffic Violation Detection System Architecture
DETECTION AND MEASUREMENT PIPELINE (runs on every processed frame)
VEHICLES · detect → track → measure speed → classify
NUMBER PLATES · tried per vehicle, again as it gets closer
Models loaded once · videos processed one at a time
AI NOTICE GENERATION — RAG + LLM (grounded in the Motor Vehicles Act and validated)
MONITORING LAYER — STREAMLIT TRAFFIC CONTROL DASHBOARD (6 screens)
Every screen reads from the FastAPI server over HTTP; the dashboard never touches the database or models directly.
NHAI · Smart City SPVs · Traffic Police
